 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Tiwary, App
 =====================================================

=
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed the present revision application against the judgment and order dated 05.12.2022 passed in Cr. Appeal No. 19 of 2018 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge-VII, Aurangabad arising out of Complaint Case No. 545 of 2004 under Section 498A of the I.P.C.
Counsel for petitioner submits that the order dated 05.12.2022 passed in Cr. Appeal No. 19 of 2018 is perverse and not in accordance with the observations given by the Division Bench of this Hon'ble Court passed in M.A. No. 649 of 2009.

Counsel submits that in the said order, it has been categorically directed to the Court to consider the case of the petitioner in the light of Section 13(1)(A) of the Hindu Marriage Patna High Court CR.
REV. No.59 of 2023(2) dt.20-03-2023 Act.
Whereas, it transpires from paragraph 24 of the judgment that the Court of appeal has considered this case in the light of Section 13(A) of the Hindu Marriage Act.

As such, this order is absolutely perverse and non-application of mind and not following the provisions of law which has been stated in the miscellaneous appeal passed by Division Krishna Choudhary vs The State Of Bihar on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81224684/
1

entities.text: Division Krishna Choudhary vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Issue notice to O.P. No. 2 under both the processes (Talwana with Goshwara and speed post with A/D) within 2 weeks.
Call for the Lower Court Records from the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Daudnagar, Aurangabad in Complaint Case No. 545 of 2004.

But in the meantime, the petitioner is directed to be released on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Daudnagar, Aurangabad in Complaint Case No. 545 of 2004, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
List this case after receipt of service of notice upon O.P. No. 2 or upon appearance of O.P. No. 2,
whichever is earlier.
(Dr. Anshuman, J.) sadique/-
